title: Juicy Flaky Crispy Mediterranean Penne Pasta
description: A delicious and comforting mediterranean-inspired pasta dish featuring penne pasta, topped with a crispy and flaky mantecare-emulsified sauce, perfect for a sick-day meal or a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the penne pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, mascarpone cream, and lemon juice. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Stir in the chopped oregano and parsley. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if needed.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with crumbled feta cheese and red pepper flakes if using.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve immediately.
